command: copilot (interactive TUI, driven under a pty)
note: copilot's gate is `permission.requested`, carrying data.permissionRequest.kind = "shell" for an `rm` — the shape source/copilot.rs already decodes to UserActionRequest { reason: "permission: shell" }. Nested under the session uuid because copilot keys its session on the transcript's PARENT DIR. The recorder's own roster and instruction attachments rode fields no decoder reads and are stripped (see `deidentified`).
